points.description: Names slow start and states that cwnd grows quickly/exponentially (e.g. +1 per ACK, doubling per RTT) while cwnd < ss_thresh, until ss_thresh is reached or a loss occurs.
Names congestion avoidance (cwnd >= ss_thresh) and states that cwnd grows slowly/linearly (e.g. +1 per RTT / after all segments acked) until a loss occurs.
States that on packet loss/congestion (in either phase) ss_thresh is set to cwnd/2 and cwnd is reset to 1.

rubric.notes: Full marks: both phases named with correct cwnd growth (exponential vs linear) and the loss reaction ss_thresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = 1. Part marks for whichever points are met. No marks for wrong phase names or reversed growth behaviour. Equivalent wording accepted.
